name: Lookout
author: Jordan Thomas (JMThomas00)
description: Thumbnail grid for your Google Home/Nest cameras. Click a tile for a floating live view; get a bar badge and a desktop notification on motion/person detection, which clears when you open the popup. Requires your own Google Device Access project (Google's one-time $5 enrollment fee applies, not charged by this plugin), go2rtc (AUR: go2rtc-bin) as the WebRTC bridge, and mpv for the floating view -- all installed separately.

barWidget.description: Badges on camera motion/person events; click for a live thumbnail grid, click a tile for a floating live view
